say:1:1910737001:1.text: The current is sweeping away the bubbles... What do I do...?
say:1:1910737001:1.source_cn: 气泡被洋流卷走了……我该怎么办……？
say:1:1910737001:1.male: The current is sweeping away the bubbles... What do I do...?
say:1:1910737001:1.female: The current is sweeping away the bubbles... What do I do...?

say:2:1910737002:1.text: The sound is getting louder... It hurts...
say:2:1910737002:1.source_cn: 声音……越来越响，好难受，我……
say:2:1910737002:1.male: The sound is getting louder... It hurts...
say:2:1910737002:1.female: The sound is getting louder... It hurts...

say:3:1910737003:1.text: No... I can't give up... I can't let it take me...!
say:3:1910737003:1.source_cn: ……不……还不能放弃……不能让声音夺走我……！
say:3:1910737003:1.male: No... I can't give up... I can't let it take me...!
say:3:1910737003:1.female: No... I can't give up... I can't let it take me...!

say:4:1910737004:1.text: My family, my friends... They're still waiting for me. I still have to find out the truth...
say:4:1910737004:1.source_cn: 我的家人，我的朋友们……他们还在等着我，我还有……想要...
say:4:1910737004:1.male: My family, my friends... They're still waiting for me. I still have to find out the truth...
say:4:1910737004:1.female: My family, my friends... They're still waiting for me. I still have to find out the truth...

say:6:1910737006:1.text: That's it! Grandma once told me that if you play the Song of the Returning Current, you can turn the current around!
say:6:1910737006:1.source_cn: ……对了！阿嬷以前教过我，奏响洄流之歌，就能让洋流转向！
say:6:1910737006:1.male: That's it! Grandma once told me that if you play the Song of the Returning Current, you can turn the current around!
say:6:1910737006:1.female: That's it! Grandma once told me that if you play the Song of the Returning Current, you can turn the current around!

say:7:1910737007:1.text: Even if I don't have an instrument, I can still sing it!
say:7:1910737007:1.source_cn: 没有乐器也没关系……我还在这里，我可以自己唱出来！
say:7:1910737007:1.male: Even if I don't have an instrument, I can still sing it!
say:7:1910737007:1.female: Even if I don't have an instrument, I can still sing it!
